description: One group e-mail with its sending log: per recipient status (pending, sent, skipped, failed) and reason. Optional recipient_status filter, limit/offset for the log.

id.description: ID of the group mailing to read

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

recipient_status.description: Only log entries with this status: pending, sent, skipped or failed

name: get_group_mailing
